channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: Two Footlongs for $12.99
item.description: Use code 1299FL at checkout on the Subway app or subway.com to get two footlong subs for $12.99, saving up to $8 versus regular prices. (Through September 12, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Chili's: 3 For Me from $10.99
item.description: All day, every day: pick a non-alcoholic drink, a starter (chips and salsa, soup, or side salad), and a full-size entree for one flat price starting at $10.99. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Footlong for $6.99
item.description: Use code FOOTLONG699 at checkout on the Subway app or subway.com to get any footlong for $6.99 at participating U.S. locations. (Through September 12, 2026)
